name: Live cart bar
description: Appears once something is in the cart: count, total and a way in.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/live-cart-bar", name: "Live cart bar", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Appears once something is in the cart: count, total and a way in.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: cart.count > 0, then: Box(padding: Insets(x: 16, y: 12), radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.primary, shadow: Shadow.lg, onTap: Navigate(to: Route.cart), ariaLabel: "View cart", child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
      Box(shape: BoxShape.circle, width: 26, height: 26, alignment: Anchor.center, background: Color.primaryInk, child: Text(child: cart.count, size: FontSize.sm, weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primary)),
      Expanded(child: Text(child: "View cart", weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: Color.primaryInk)),
      Text(child: formatMoney(cart.total_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primaryInk)
    ])))
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
